notes: WebFetch was refused for rameyvethospital.com (robots_disallowed), doctorpetpr.com/doctores/ (client_error), cruzvet.com (client_error) and friendsofculebraanimals.org (client_error); Ramey Veterinary Hospital (Aguadilla, 787-819-0586) and Cruz Veterinary Services (Fajardo, 787-449-3192) are only in the CMVPR list and were not added. CMVPR tags as 'Emergencia' but no own page opened: Hospital Veterinario San Francisco de Asis (Hatillo, 787-879-5251), Emergencias Veterinarias del Sur (Ponce, 787-913-1363). No own site found for Mayagüez, Ponce, Rincón or Culebra clinics (Culebra: only a Friends of Culebra Animals page, unreachable). No island poison line or duty rota found in Puerto Rico; the two US poison lines do not state PR coverage. Not opened: Veterinary Specialty Hospital, CEVET (cevet.net llms.txt had no contact data), Old San Juan Veterinary Center, Ocean Park, Fajardo Animal Hospital, Mayagüez and Ponce clinics. Colegio de Médicos Veterinarios has no duty-rota page found. Remaining work: open those clinics' own sites, and confirm the two Hatillo/Ponce emergency clinics. Independent check 2026-11-13: the two US poison lines (Pet Poison Helpline, ASPCA) removed because their pages do not state Puerto Rico/US-territory coverage.
